Short title and commencement

ORDINANCE XXXVIII OF 1997
ORDINANCE XXXVIII OF 1997
TAX ADJUSTMENTS (AMENDMENT)
ORDINANCE, 1997
An Ordinance further to amend the
Central Excises Act, 1944 (1 of 1944) and the Customs Act, 1969 (IV of 1969)
[Gazette of Pakistan, Extraordinary,
Part I, 28th February, 1997]
F.Nu.2(1)/97‑Pub., dated 28‑2‑1997.‑‑The
following Ordinance made by the President is hereby published for general
information:‑‑
Whereas it is expedient to amend the
Central Excises Act, 1944 (I of 1944) and the Customs Act, 1969 (IV of 1969),
for the purposes hereinafter appearing;
And whereas the National Assembly is
not in session and the President is satisfied that circumstances exist which
render it necessary to take immediate action;
Now, therefore, in exercise of the
powers ‑conferred by clause (1) of Article 89 of the Constitution of the
Islamic Republic of Pakistan, the President is pleased to make and promulgate
the following Ordinance:‑‑
1. Short title and commencement.‑‑(1) This Ordinance may
be called the Tax Adjustments (Amendment) Ordinance, 1997.
(2) It shall come into force on the
day the Tax Adjustments Ordinance, 1996 (LXXXIX of 1996) shall stand repealed.

3. Amendment of Act IV of 1969.‑‑In the Customs Act,
1969 (IV of 1969), after section 18A, the following new section shall be
inserted, namely:‑‑
"18B. Levy of service
charge.‑‑‑The Federal Government may, by Notification in
the official Gazette, levy a service charge equivalent to two per cent. ad
valorem on all such goods specified in the First Schedule to this Act as are
subject to pre‑shipment inspection:
Provided that for the purposes of
Sales Tax Act, 1990, such service charge shall not constitute a part of the
value of supply.".
